title: Intermittent failures are found before the merge queue finds them
description: Serves every change to main reaching a working server (the dogfood's redeploy, JS-198). 10 of 20 counted merge-queue runs through 2026-11-27 failed for causes that were not the queued change, each a different cause, each forced and fixed once in the test kit or CI. This task finds the rest by repeated runs under CI's shape, outside the queue, and fixes each one at its cause. It takes over the investigation of the lead-limit test that found 2 jobs where it wanted the paused one. D-20261127-queue-reliability.
acceptanceCriteria: The integration tier is run repeatedly under CI's shape (test/ffmpeg61.sh, ffmpeg 6.1, 2 CPUs pinned per shard with JELLYSCALE_TEST_CPUS that no other run uses, a fresh Postgres each run, the shard deal of the merged six-way split) on a machine no queue, measurement or other lane uses, within a budget of 16 machine-hours in all. docs/testing.md records each run (the commit, the shard, the conclusion, and for each failure the test, its first error line and a verdict as in JS-175 criterion 1) and the hours spent.

Each failure, whether found by these runs or by a queue run while the task is open, is fixed at its cause in the test kit or CI. Before the fix its condition is forced once with real processes or real contention and the test fails as the log shows; after the fix the same forcing passes. The procedure and both results go in docs/testing.md. If a cause is the product's, it comes to the product owner as a brief before any product change. A cause that cannot be forced or reproduced within the budget is recorded as unknown and joins BL-314.

No merge-queue run reaches a third-party package source at run time: CI's packages come from a pinned or cached source, so that source answering 403 or changing cannot stop a run (D-20261127-js175-count's trigger, met by the fourth stop).

After this task merges, the next 10 merge_group runs that run the integration tier are counted in docs/testing.md as in JS-175 criterion 7. If more than 1 of them fails for a cause other than the queued change, the count comes to the product owner as a brief. The task is not extended without that brief.

No retry, no skip, no raised timeout or widened bound, no lengthened lease, and no check amended to pass. No product code is changed to fit a test. No test of the kit is committed (D-069). No viewer-visible change.
notes: ux: false, core: false. Runs in a lane of its own beside JS-216, JS-184 and JS-186 and holds no merge. Its runs never share a machine with a queue run or a measurement. JS-221 shrinks the queue first, because it removes the differential job. JS-175 still closes on its own count and is not reopened here. Lead's note: this development machine is shared and is not that spare machine; GitHub-hosted runners of the public repository are fresh CI-shaped machines, run few at a time so queue runs are not delayed.
